summary: This bill permanently allows high-deductible health plans to cover telehealth services before the deductible is met, by amending the Internal Revenue Code to remove the expiration date for this provision.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to permanently exempt telehealth services from certain high deductible health plan rules. This change affects how health savings accounts (HSAs) interact with telehealth, potentially making HSAs more attractive or flexible for some taxpayers, which is a minor adjustment to tax-related health policy.
